claims.evidence: Witness report shows the keyboard/piano and a label/sticker reading “PSR-550”, but does not show it powering on, playing keys, display functioning, or sound output.
Witness report: label/sticker near the lower left area reads “PSR-550” (photo 0).

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: keys/buttons/display/speakers may be faulty even if the unit looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, the display turning on, pressing multiple keys, and playing a preset with audible sound through the built-in speakers (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly non-working until a power-on + sound test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables) could prevent use.
risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out (adapter, sustain pedal, any cables) with close-ups of model/connector types.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing and buyer may need to source them.

risks.risk: Key condition issues (sticking/broken keys/uneven action) not visible from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Video showing a full octave run (left-to-right) and demonstrating sustain pedal response (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible key wear and reduced playability.

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear/damage (dust/scratches) may indicate heavier use or impacts affecting function.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the display area, control panel buttons, and any cracks/impact points, plus a screen-on shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst cosmetic condition shown (wear/scratches) without assuming functionality.

risks.risk: Internal faults not visible externally (e.g., speaker distortion, power supply issues, intermittent buttons).
risks.proof: Video clip showing sustained playing for 1–2 minutes with volume changes and no cut-outs; include a headphone test if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially having intermittent faults until stability is demonstrated.

proof_requests: Power-on video: display lights up, buttons respond, and at least 2–3 different sounds/presets are selected.
Sound test: audible output from built-in speakers (and/or headphone jack) with volume up/down.
Show included accessories: power adapter and sustain pedal (if any), with clear photos of connectors.
Key test video: play a full range (at least one octave up and down) to confirm no dead/sticking keys.
Close-ups of the display/control panel and any damaged areas, plus a screen-on photo.
response.reason: The model identification (PSR-550) is supported by the label, but the seller’s “working perfectly” claim is not verifiable from the witness photos because power-on, sound output, and key/button functionality are not shown.
